rulers.name: Duke Jing (or Ai, or Yi) of Jin

ledger.x: c. 1042: King Cheng gives Tang to his brother, founding Jin. 'King Cheng of Zhou... gave the land called Tang (唐)... to his younger brother, Tang Shuyu'; rulers table 'Shu Yu of Tang 1042 BC–?'; infobox 'Established: 11th century BC'. Tang's place and size are not on the page.
746: a branch holds Quwo against the Jin marquises.
678: Duke Wu of Quwo conquers Jin.
678: the Quwo branch takes the Jin throne.
676-651: Duke Xian annexes the small states of Shanxi.
ledger.cp: small states of Shanxi (Geng, Huo, old Wei, Yu, Western Guo)

ledger.x: 635: King Xiang rewards Duke Wen of Jin with Henei and Yangfan.
550: Cliopatria's Jin shape grows by about 17,000 km2 at Qi's expense.
450: 9 cells of Wey's shape pass to Jin in Cliopatria.
450: 21 cells of Jin's west-south edge pass to Chu in Cliopatria.
403: Han is recognised as a marquisate.
403: Wei is recognised as a marquisate (same sentence as Han).
403: Zhao is recognised as a marquisate (same sentence as Han).

wars.name: Quwo-Jin conflict
wars.outcome: The Quwo branch conquered Jin in 678 and killed Marquis Min; Duke Wu ruled as Duke of Jin 678-677.

wars.name: Jin-Qin wars
wars.outcome: Qin captured Duke Hui in 646 and restored him as a vassal; Jin defeated Qin in 627 and invaded in 625; no border moved.

wars.name: Jin-Chu wars (Chengpu, Bi and Yanling)
wars.outcome: Jin and its allies defeated Chu at Chengpu (632) and Yanling (575); Chu defeated Jin in 598; Jin was recognised as hegemon; no border moved.

wars.name: Battle of An
wars.outcome: Jin defeated Qi, which had invaded Lu and Wey.

wars.name: Wars among the Jin clans and the destruction of the Zhi
wars.outcome: Zhonghang, Fan and Handan attacked Zhao in 497; the Handan clan fell in 471 and Fan in 470; the Zhi besieged Jinyang from 455 and were annihilated by Zhao, Han and Wei in 453.

certainty.note: No treaty or survey line exists for the whole life: the Jin frontier with the Rong, Di and neighbouring states is approximate, and the dukes' real domain after 453 is much smaller than the drawn shape.
